palette.primary_role: BetterUp blue for primary CTAs and links. Dark navy/black for headings and brand marks. Coaching brands commonly use a confident blue-navy or deep purple as their dominant brand color. Tony Robbins uses deeper blue (~#0072CE), Mindvalley uses deep purple-black.
palette.accent_role: Warm accent colors create emotional urgency and contrast. Tony Robbins uses orange for free-book CTAs and event registration. CoachHub uses pink for demo CTAs. Noom uses green for health/wellness psychology. Accents are used sparingly — primarily on primary CTAs and key conversion elements.
palette.surface_role: Background color hierarchy: white for clean sections, warm off-white (#f4f3e9 from BetterUp) for softer brand sections, light blue tint for callouts, neutral-light for cards. Light mode dominant — coaching brands prioritize warmth and approachability over dark mode (Tony Robbins is the exception with dramatic dark/black hero sections).
palette.neutral_role: BetterUp body text is near-black (#2f3033). Secondary text is desaturated gray (#62646e, observed on Noom's mock). Tertiary/muted text (#8a8f98). Text is slightly softer than pure black to reduce eye strain — coaching is about readability and trust.
palette.border_role: Thin, light gray borders on cards and inputs. Coaching sites use subtle borders — cards are often distinguished by background color or shadow rather than hard borders. Softer, more human feel.

typography.notes: Coaching typography ranges from enterprise-clean (BetterUp: Sohne-Buch custom, h1 at 110px) to dramatic-condensed (Tony Robbins: Druk-like display, bold and cinematic) to approachable-modern (Noom: Macan, 'Helvetica Neue' fallback, friendly and soft). Heading weights are typically 600-700, never ultra-light — coaching needs to feel confident and bold. Body fonts are clean sans-serifs at 16-18px for readability.

elevation.shadows: soft and shallow — coaching sites avoid harsh shadows for a more human, approachable feel

typical_order: header (sticky, logo left, nav center, CTA right — 'Request a demo' or 'Sign up' always visible)

hero (FULL-SCREEN image or video with overlaid bold headline + subtext + dual CTA + trust bar. Coaching hero is the MOST emotionally charged section — often a personal photo of the coach/founder or aspirational human imagery. Height: 93-100svh)
trust_bar (scrolling logo carousel: Fortune 500 client logos or media logos like Forbes/NYT/CNN. 5-10 logos. Auto-scrolling infinite loop)
stats (large number counter animation: '21% uptick', '300% increase', '3,500+ coaches'. 3-4 key metrics with short labels)
problem_solution (split section: left text 'The problem' + right text 'The solution' or alternating)
how_it_works (numbered steps 01-04 with icons/illustrations. Often shows app/coaching interface screenshots)
product_pillars (3-6 cards: e.g., BetterUp's Lead/Manage/Grow/Ready, Tony Robbins' Mindset/Wealth/Health, Mindvalley's 6 archetype cards)

testimonials (the MOST important section in coaching. Celebrity or executive quotes with headshots. Video testimonial cards. Quote + name + title + company logo. Often a carousel with 5-8 testimonials. Sometimes Stanford/Harvard study results)
programs_pricing (course/event cards with pricing. Tony Robbins: event location cards. Mindvalley: membership overview. CoachHub: enterprise plans)
coach_showcase (featured coaches/instructors with photos, bios, specialties. Human faces are critical trust elements)
resource_hub (blog articles, podcast episodes, case studies in card grid. Category filters)
final_cta (centered, often dark bg, emotional headline + primary CTA + 'no risk' reassurance text)
footer (4-5 column: product/platform/resources/company/legal + social icons + copyright)
hero_variants: personal_photo_video (Tony Robbins style — large hero image of the coach/founder, dramatic lighting, bold condensed headline overlaid, 'Get Your Free Book' CTA in warm accent color. Often full-screen video background)

rotating_headline (BetterUp style — full-screen height (93-100svh), animated rotating word in headline: 'Better [performance/productivity/innovation] across the board', dark background, trust stats grid below, Mercedes-AMG F1 trust badge)
human_centered_saas (CoachHub style — headline left + human photo right, 'Transform people and organizations', demo CTA + client logo scroll, professional enterprise SaaS feel with human warmth)

aspirational_dark (Mindvalley style — dark/black background, mystical/transformational imagery, 'A better you every day', membership CTA + 'Featured on' media bar, full-screen program imagery carousel)
app_preview (Noom style — coaching-adjacent health app, phone mockup + headline, psychology-based positioning, 'Stop dieting. Get lifelong results.', friendly and approachable, bright photography)
card_variants: product_pillar_card (BetterUp: icon + label + heading + description + 'Learn about →' link. 4 cards: Lead, Manage, Grow, Ready)
event_card (Tony Robbins: event image + colored logo + title + date/location + CTA. Horizontal carousel with chevron navigation)
testimonial_card (Industry standard: circular headshot photo 64x64 + quote + name + title + company. Often video thumbnail overlay. Carousel format common)

archetype_card (Mindvalley: portrait orientation 750x1120, background image + icon + label + 'Select path' CTA. 6 cards: Career Growth, Business Growth, Master My Body, Life Transition, Love Connection, Spiritual Seeker)
step_card (CoachHub: numbered 01-04, mobile mockup image + step title + description + dual CTAs. AI matching → global sessions → content → measurement)
resource_card (Blog/podcast: thumbnail + category badge + date + title. Horizontal scrollable row)
program_card (Mindvalley: wide format 2400x1080, instructor photo + program name. Academy/Mastery, Certified Coach, Events)

coaching_specific_patterns.emotional_imagery: All 5 brands use large, emotionally resonant photography — real human faces, dramatic lighting, aspirational settings. Stock photos are rare; custom photography and video dominate.
coaching_specific_patterns.trust_amplification: Coaching sites have the highest density of trust signals of any industry: client logos, media logos, celebrity endorsements, academic study results, certifications, coach credentials, student counts, and video testimonials all appear on a single page.
coaching_specific_patterns.transformation_narrative: Sections follow a story arc: problem → pain → solution → proof → call to action. The emotional journey is designed into the section order.
coaching_specific_patterns.lead_magnet_cta: Nearly all coaching sites offer a free introductory resource: free book, free quiz, free session, free assessment. This is the primary conversion mechanism, distinct from SaaS 'free trial'.
coaching_specific_patterns.video_backgrounds: Tony Robbins and Mindvalley use video backgrounds in hero sections. Video testimonials are common. The coaching industry values face-to-face connection simulation.

tone_profile.headline_style: Coaching headlines are aspirational and personal — they speak directly to the visitor's desired transformation. Common patterns: 'Better [X] every day' (Mindvalley), 'Transform [X] and [Y]' (CoachHub), '[Bold promise] across the board' (BetterUp). Headlines focus on OUTCOMES not features. Often short (3-8 words) with emotionally charged language. Personal pronouns ('your', 'you') are heavily used. Celebrity or social proof embedded directly in hero: 'Celebrating 35 years of Awaken the Giant Within' (Tony Robbins).
tone_profile.cta_style: Coaching CTAs are invitation-based rather than transactional. 'Become a Member', 'Get Your Free Book', 'Request a demo' — the language implies joining something aspirational. Free/resource CTAs are more prominent than purchase CTAs. Dual CTAs are standard: primary action + secondary learn/watch. Tony Robbins uses contrasting accent colors (orange) for free resource CTAs to make them pop against dark backgrounds.
trust_signals: celebrity_endorsements (Serena Williams, Klay Thompson, Marc Benioff — Tony Robbins; Zain Asher CNN anchor — Mindvalley)
client_logos (Google, Moderna, Workday, Salesforce, Accenture, Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 — BetterUp; Toyota, Coca-Cola, Virgin Atlantic, Booking.com — CoachHub)
media_logos (Forbes, Fortune, Inc., NYT, CNN, BBC, USA Today, Entrepreneur — used by Tony Robbins and Mindvalley in 'Featured on' bars)
academic_study_results (Stanford University study: 300% cognitive increase, 139% performance biochemistry — Tony Robbins; specific percentage lifts: 21% workforce efficiency, 6x retention — BetterUp)
coach_credentials ('Only top 5% of applicants', '3,500+ coaches' — CoachHub; '6,000 new coaches trained annually' — Mindvalley)
scale_stats ('1,000+ enterprise companies', '90+ countries', '80 languages' — CoachHub; '1M+ subscribers' — Mindvalley)
video_testimonials (8 video cards on Tony Robbins page with attendee quotes; endorsement videos on Mindvalley)
case_studies (BetterUp: detailed per-company stats like 'Google increased strategic planning by 29%'; CoachHub: named testimonials from Virgin Atlantic and Schneider Electric executives)
anti_patterns: fake urgency or countdown timers (undermines coaching credibility)
generic stock photos (coaching audiences detect inauthenticity immediately)
jargon-heavy without explanation (coaching spans personal and professional — accessibility matters)
feature lists without human context (coaching sells outcomes and transformation, not features)
cold corporate tone (too formal kills the emotional connection that coaching depends on)
single CTA in hero (coaching audiences vary in readiness — always offer two paths)

color_mood: enterprise_blue (BetterUp: #009FD9 primary, #f4f3e9 warm off-white surfaces, #2f3033 dark text — professional, credible, modern coaching platform for Fortune 500. Performance and data-driven.)

cinematic_dark (Tony Robbins: #000000 or near-black hero bg, #0072CE blue primary, #F47920 orange accent — high-drama, high-energy, stage-like presence. Condensed bold typography. Arena-level energy.)
human_pink (CoachHub: white/light surfaces, pink accent, professional enterprise SaaS with warmth. Pink organic shape decorations. Human-centric with corporate polish.)
mystical_dark (Mindvalley: dark/black backgrounds, deep purple gradients, gold/white accents — spiritual, transformational, premium. Mystical imagery with tech-forward positioning.)
wellness_green (Noom: white backgrounds, #1DBF73 green primary, friendly approachable tone — psychology-based health coaching. Soft, bright, encouraging.)
typography_mood: enterprise_humanist (BetterUp: Sohne-Buch custom heading, Rise/Avenir body — clean but warm, large sizes (h1 110px), sophisticated but not cold)
condensed_cinematic (Tony Robbins: Druk/Druk Condensed-like display font, bold weights, tight spacing — dramatic, powerful, arena-event energy)
geometric_modern (CoachHub/Mindvalley: Inter or similar geometric sans, clean and legible, professional but accessible)
friendly_approachable (Noom: Macan with Helvetica Neue fallback, soft and round, approachable health-app aesthetic)
layout_density: spacious_enterprise (BetterUp: 112px section padding, generous whitespace, large typography, full-screen hero — premium enterprise feel with room to breathe)
scroll_driven (Tony Robbins: multiple horizontal carousels, dense scroll-driven narrative, event cards and testimonial cards packed in swipeable rows — high energy, lots to explore)
balanced_saas (CoachHub: standard enterprise SaaS density, alternating white/dark sections, 4-column grids, manageable information density)
immersive_discovery (Mindvalley: card-heavy with archetype and program grids, dark theme reduces visual fatigue, designed for browsing and exploration)

landing_page.key_differentiator: Testimonials and trust signals are the most important sections after hero. Social proof must appear within the first 3 scroll depths.

about_page.best_practices: Coaching about pages center on the founder's personal transformation story. Tony Robbins: the personal journey IS the brand. BetterUp: scientific and academic credentials highlighted.

events_page.best_practices: Tony Robbins pattern: event cards with location images, dates, and pricing. Video highlights from past events. Countdown to next event.
